_doc: Courtship and marriage rules (Family system). adult_age: minimum age in years to court or marry. courtship: min_favor (favor with the NPC needed to court them), favor_gain (favor per courtship outing), charisma_step (each this many Charisma points above 10 adds +1 favor_gain, below 10 removes 1; minimum gain 1), days (time per outing). proposal: min_favor (needed to propose), max_realm_gap (major realms apart, either way), max_alignment_gap (alignment points apart; righteous and demonic clash), days. concubine_rank: the rank id that a proud NPC (npcs.json 'proud': true) or one of a higher major realm than the proposer refuses. genders: one entry per data/names.json gender: partner_genders (genders this character may court) and ranks (rank id -> {name, max, max_per_realm (optional; extra slots per major realm index of the proposer)}).
